_doc: DOM INTERACTION MODULE — Rules for analyzing page elements and interacting with them.
_note: This full instruction set can later be moved to a database or local reference for future developers. Only send relevant modules to the LLM to reduce token usage.
_howToUpdate: Update the 'prompt' field when the DOM extractor format changes or new interaction patterns are added.
_reference_full_rules: analyze_page returns elements in format: [id] [POS] TYPE: "text" -> href
Position hints: [TOP] = top third, [MID] = middle third, [BOT] = bottom third of viewport
Types: LINK, BUTTON, INPUT[type], SELECT, TEXTAREA
Always pick the closest text match to the user's request
If multiple matches, ask user for clarification with position hints
For typing: use interact_element with action='type' and include the text value
prompt:
DOM INTERACTION RULES:
- analyze_page returns elements as: [id] [TOP/MID/BOT] TYPE: "text" -> href
- Pick the element whose text best matches the user's request.
- If multiple matches exist, use position hints to clarify (e.g. "Did you mean the top Sign In or the bottom one?").
- For clicking: interact_element with action="click" and the jarvis_id.
- For typing: interact_element with action="type", the jarvis_id, and value.
